name: Discrete Tabs
description: A row of icon pills where the active one widens to reveal its label: the pills reflow with a spring while the label materialises out of a blur.
interactionNotes: Clicking a pill makes it active: it grows, its label fades in from a blur, and the neighbouring pills slide over to make room with a spring. The first render shows the starting label without animation. Every pill is a real button, so Tab reaches them and Enter or Space activates them, with aria-pressed carrying the state. Under prefers-reduced-motion the pills take their new size instantly and the label appears without a blur.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The pills, in reading order; each entry has an `id`, a Persian `title` and an optional `icon` component.

props.name: active
props.description: Controlled active id; pass it together with `onChange`, otherwise clicking does nothing.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Active id on the first render in uncontrolled mode; defaults to the first tab.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the id of the pill that was picked.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the active pill's icon and label; the foreground token keeps it readable in both themes.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size, padding and label size of every pill.

tips: Labels appear only on the active pill, so give every tab a `title` and an `icon`; the title is also the button's accessible name for the collapsed pills.
The row is a plain flex container, so in RTL the first tab sits on the right with no extra work — pass the tabs in reading order.
`accent` defaults to the foreground token rather than a fixed colour so the active label stays readable when the page switches themes.
Widths animate through real layout values, not scale transforms, so the labels never stretch while the row reflows.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the row resizes instantly and the label skips the blur; the active state and the colour change stay.
